newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London steady, IBM weaker.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London steady, IBM weaker.

text.p: U.S. stocks in London were mixed on Tuesday as investors awaited Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey Hawkins testimony to a U.S. Congress banking subcommittee and digested results from International Business Machines Corp, dealers said.

IBM shares were quoted $3-5/8 lower at $100 after the computer giant reported late on Monday second quarter earnings of $1.46 a share, up from $1.26 a share the previous year, adjusted for a two-for-one stock split.
